# Optional else: absent branch returns 0, selected branch retains its value and lexical scope.
if 1 { 7 } => 7
if 0 { missing } => 0
let x = 1; if x { x = 2; x }; x => 2
let x = 3; if 0 { x = 99 }; x => 3
fn total(n) { let acc = 0; let i = 0; while i < n { i = i + 1; if i % 2 == 0 { acc = acc + i } }; acc }; total(4) => 6
if 1 { let local = [4]; local }[0] => 4
if 0 { 1 } + 5 => 5
0 && if 1 { missing } => 0
1 || if 0 { missing } => 1
match 0 { 0 => if 1 { 7 }, _ => 9 } => 7
if 0 { 1 } else { 8 } => 8
if 1 { 2 } else { missing } => 2
if 1 { 2 } else => error:expected closing brace
if 1 { 2 => error:expected closing brace
if 0 { 1 + * } => 0
if 1 { 1 + * } => error:expected integer
if 0 { 2 }; local => error:undefined identifier
if [1] { 2 } => error:expected integer
